rows.notes: The document is a narrative review (self-described as amalgamating ten studies) with no original data, experiment, survey or model runs. Productivity figures mentioned (e.g., 10.21% yield increase over manual irrigation in paddy fields) are reported from other work (AgriSens/Roy et al.; Alsammak et al.), not the review's own result.

Review paper with no primary data. Statements about IoT irrigation optimizing water usage are summaries of cited studies (Roy et al. AgriSens, Alsammak et al., Dasgupta et al.) rather than the review's own findings; no quantitative water-saving result is reported even second-hand.

notes: Conference review paper (IC3IoT 2024) summarising weed-detection and IoT irrigation literature; contains a comparison table of challenges but no original experiments. Q1 is 'no' for both rows, so all other questions are 'no'.
